title: Final Momentum Answers
description: Essential Criteria - Provide correct expressions for the maximum and minimum momentum of the muon in terms of m_mu, m_pi, and p.

title: Muon Helicity
description: Important Criteria - Correctly determine and explain the helicity of the muon based on the helicity of the neutrino.

title: Positron Helicity
description: Important Criteria - Accurately identify the helicity of the positron and justify the reasoning behind it.

title: Lepton Number Conservation
description: Essential Criteria - Clearly state the conservation of lepton numbers and their association with the neutrinos and leptons involved.

title: Decay Rate Explanation
description: Optional Criteria - Provide a reasonable explanation for the difference in decay rates between muons and electrons.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria - Watch for common sign mistakes in the momentum expressions or helicity assignments.

title: Units Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria - Ensure that all quantities are expressed with consistent units throughout the calculations.
